name: Bosch EDC17CP14 (VAG 2.0 TDI common rail)
eeprom: Emulated in the TC1796 128 KiB data flash

read_methods.notes: OBD writing and virtual reads are documented. Complete original reads over OBD are unconfirmed across revisions. Closed-case bench communication uses CAN. A usable boot entry point is unconfirmed.

notes: Higher-output VAG 2.0 TDI common-rail (EA189) ECU, about 2008-2013. The EDC17 checksum's VAG per-block constant is firmware-specific: OpenTune corrects it with the owner's stock dump as reference. ecupinouts documents a second hardware variant grounded on T94-2 instead of T94-1 - check continuity.

connectors.name: T94
connectors.description: 94-pin vehicle-side block of the 154-pin (60 + 94) Bosch connector (Transpondery: socket K)

pins.note: Only on the second hardware variant listed by ecupinouts.

bench.notes: +12 V to T94-87 (terminal 30) and T94-5 (terminal 15), ground T94-1 (T94-2 on some hardware), CAN-H T94-68 / CAN-L T94-67.
bench.resistor_notes: Put a 120 ohm resistor across CAN-H/CAN-L if your interface does not terminate (ecupinouts).

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

sources.title: ECUTools: Bosch EDC17CP14 TC1796 VAG bench manual (CPU identification)

AUTOM8-OBD supported vehicles (VAG EDC17CP14 2.0 TDI TP20)
Microtronik HexProg 1.0.33 support announcement (VAG EDC17CP14 read support and flash variants)

flash_note: The 2048 KiB figure covers the TC1796's internal program flash (Infineon, section 3.2). Microtronik also lists external-flash versions of the VAG EDC17CP14. External flash capacity is unknown.

obd.protocol: TP2.0 over CAN for the 2.0 TDI listed by AUTOM8
obd.notes: AUTOM8 lists writing and virtual reads. A virtual read does not capture the installed flash. Microtronik also reports direct reads on some versions, without specifying their coverage or the revisions involved.

bench.how: The T94 connector carries +12 V permanent on T94-87, ignition on T94-5, CAN high on T94-68 and CAN low on T94-67. The primary layout uses ground T94-1 and auxiliary GPT1 on T60-52 and GPT2 on T60-44 for bench programming. The second ecupinouts layout uses ground T94-2 and omits both GPT lines. Neither layout lists a K-line. Confirm the ground by continuity before applying power.

boot.mcu_mode: The TC1796 supports serial bootstrap over ASC0 or CAN (Infineon, Table 7). The mode used on this ECU is unknown.
boot.notes: The processor data sheet describes chip-level boot choices. The available pinout evidence does not establish a usable point, strap action and reset sequence for an identified EDC17CP14 board revision.

security.notes: The OBD support list does not specify security access requirements for a complete diagnostic read or for flash programming. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
